defs.def: a measurement of how good, popular, important, etc. sb/sth is, especially in relation to other people or things 等级；级别
a set of figures that show how many people watch or listen to a particular television or radio programme, used to show how popular a programme is 收视率；收听率

ex.s: “People who live in plant-rich environments report a higher life satisfaction rating, ” she says.
ex.t: 并且要注意手边的食物。

defs.def: a number or letter that shows which groups of people a particular film/movie is suitable for 表示电影分级的数字（或字母）；电影的等级
a sailor in the navy who is not an officer 海军士兵；水手

ex.s: With the development of information technology and data analysis, more and more countries are building their own credit systems with objective credit rating methods.
ex.t: 随着信息技术和数据分析的发展，越来越多的国家正在用客观的信用评级方法建立自己的信用体系。

ex.s: And why do some adaptations get lower ratings than others?
ex.t: 为什么有些改编作品的评分比其他作品低？

ex.s: Find some interesting reviews of the film.What ratings did the film receive?
ex.t: 找一些关于这部电影的有趣评论。这部电影得到了什么评分？

ex.s: Of course, some advertisements are not so obvious: product placement is typically used in films with huge box-office success and TV shows with high ratings.
ex.t: 当然，有些广告不那么明显：植入式广告通常用于票房大获成功的电影和高收视率的电视节目中。
